compile_error_invisible_to_probe.reason: Verdict.mutation has no compile_error field; probe total = killed+survived+timeout+no_coverage
compile_error_invisible_to_probe.evidence: getSpendVsReplacement killed_ids run 1..17,19 — id 18 was rejected by the type checker
compile_error_invisible_to_probe.implication: Stryker's typescript-checker is alive on TypeScript 6.0.3, re-confirming the baseline's question 3, but the probe cannot report it

cost_per_candidate.regression_to_watch: generate is 2.6x the baseline and completion tokens 2.5x — longer prompt, and the exemplar's fake-timer scaffolding copied into tasks that do not need a clock

recommendations: TEST_FILE_PATTERN must not exclude files under src/ — the only thing between 0/8 and 3/8 on this project
bodyRange must not brace-match into a return-type annotation — it hid an 18-mutant function and called it unplannable
scripts/plan-ranges.mjs must call deriveLineRange — it failed on 5 of 5 functions here and is the script the planner agent is told to use
the sandbox must skip symlinked directories Stryker cannot copy (baseline blocker 5, unfixed and unrecorded)
the prompt needs a way to name types the signature depends on — the plan's notes already has the answer and notes is never rendered
planner-tokens.mjs needs dir.replace(/[/_]/g,'-') and a way to see subagent transcripts
Verdict.mutation should carry compile_error so the probe's four-way split can report it
a plan whose signature is unqualified on a class member should be a validation warning
deviations: src/modules/auth/auth.config.test.ts renamed (and its one importer updated) on a cp -Rc clone of the project, for the repaired measurement only; the unmodified project was also run and its 0/8 is reported first
.claude/agents and .claude/skills removed from that same clone (Stryker cannot copy symlinked directories)
ts-jest diagnostics:false applied to the throwaway branch's package.json jest transform — the one authorised workaround; isolatedModules deliberately not used
the test-planner agent is not registered in a Claude Code session and was driven as an Opus subagent given claude/agents/test-planner.md
getSpendVsReplacement's line range hand-corrected to [100,124] after the probe reported no_mutants; the probe's own output is reported unaltered alongside
planner-tokens.mjs run from a locally patched copy (one character in the slug regex); sidecrew's source was not modified
Stryker installed with yarn 1.22.22 via npx so the committed v1 lockfile was not rewritten into Berry format
not_deviated_from: nothing in the project's src/ or test/ was modified
